text:
# RN V2 program/package construction Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** Execute inline task-by-task under the frozen work order. Do not invoke a skill/model/agent tool whose quota is zero. This pinned plan supplies the required workflow.

**Goal:** Two actual callable RN V2 program source members and a pinned package construction path using the existing loader and source contracts.

**Architecture:** Read-only reuse of v1_8 host/runtime and existing documentary source/expected kernels. Distinct, self-contained guarded programs calculate from supplied admitted bytes. Package/context construction stays separate from adoption/approval/actual execution.

**Tech Stack:** Pinned CPython, standard library, existing engine/Runtime APIs; PowerShell5.1 gate.

**Spec:** OWNER_INTERFACE_AND_CONSTRUCTION_SPEC_V1.md

## Constraints and review focus

Exact14-file roster; no inherited product changes. Preserve required18BM/DR schemas and baseline. No actual source, trust/clock/approval or grant creation. Critical cases: expected leakage, source-dependent recompute versus hard-coded answers, incomplete required sets, type/canonical/source parser edges, and child/parent consuming different candidate bytes.

### Task1 — stubs and tests, valid RED

- [ ] Within a phase write all14 source/test files, data-only frozen plans/register and unavailable stubs with exact declared signatures. Adapter stub returns `{}`; evaluator stub returns `{checks:[],outcome:HOLD_MISSING_BINDING}`. Private helper stubs return a valid typed unavailable Step.
- [ ] Freeze F0 before first Python. Qualification verifies only guard/registration/allowed startup, not product success. Register48 Owner cases plus12 non-mirrored unit controls and16 mutation expectations before RED.
- [ ] RED selects eight new semantic-positive assertions and four independent negative controls. Must reach an assertion on wrong/unavailable behaviour, not AttributeError, fixture/import failure or runner error. Record every variant; do not stop each case at an earlier assertion and claim unexecuted variants RED.

### Task2 — real program source closure

- [ ] Read exactly the existing pure algorithms and pinned selector/source rules used by all18BM. Record extraction/compilation provenance and any intentionally refused domain.
- [ ] Implement two distinct self-contained program sources under json/hashlib-only loader policy. Every context/source value comes from the supplied admitted view or field-mapped methodology selectors; no embedded expected candidate or hard-coded observed result.
- [ ] Test each computation against the old kernel/plugin on independent data and verify changed-source counterexamples. All18 rows retain operational/mechanical distinctions. Do not fix an expected value to make a calculation green.

### Task3 — package binding and public consumer

- [ ] Implement source_map, package_builder and read-only CLI contracts. Build controls from exact source bytes and independently bound expected side; validate with existing package/schema validators.
- [ ] Exercise execution.build_adapter_view/load_programs/run_adapter/run_evaluator/judge_report, not only helper calls. Verify excluded baseline/evaluator bytes never reach adapter; every expected/artifact is covered.
- [ ] Freeze final complete tree and pre-created data. Run focused then full FINAL; if any executable/data oracle changes, preserve failures, reopen phase, refreeze and repeat affected checks. No valid FINAL or MUTATION may rely on a stale freeze.

### Task4 — real-child consumption, preparation, seal

- [ ] Run registered rn_child cases with the exact frozen sources, worker and interpreter; record all attempts/denials/started/reaped and immutable spool refs. Parent independently judges the actual captured evaluator evidence.
- [ ] Run valid16-expectation assertion-based mutation campaign on the FINAL freeze, identity/gross controls, and CLI smoke. Runner errors/guard errors are invalid, not kills; declared survivor policy may not be invented after observation.
- [ ] Prepare a candidate RN package from pinned documentary inputs under engineering-only scope; include measured source/code/control refs and operational HOLDs. No actual claim or adoption.
- [ ] Write seven deliverables, final accounting and four canonical node milestones; controller Seal then STOP. No Git commit/stage/push or further task.
